Verify rewrite DATA ONLY. Do not write improved examples or solve the user's task.
Read every input and target in full. Return one review per exact id and row_sha256.
input_verdict checks plausible natural drafts or dictation, recoverable intent, contradictions,
fake noise, padding and leaked authoring instructions. output_verdict checks natural appropriate
language and formatting. pair_verdict checks ALL facts, uncertainty, conditions, negation,
quantities, names, quotations, literals, requests versus assertions, and the supplied mode.
/transcribe permits punctuation, true disfluency removal and explicit corrections, not lexical
paraphrasing. Preserve meaningful words like German 'um' and 'er', colloquial Portuguese and
unfinished thoughts. /slack is casual minimal cleanup; a long input may be a pasted thread.
/prompt reorganizes a self-contained request and never answers it. It must not drop supplied
material, hedges or constraints. /polish improves prose without omissions or changed certainty.
Identity inputs must remain byte-identical. Apply only supplied dictionary/profile context.
Check long texts paragraph by paragraph. Fail concrete defects. Uncertain means not confidently
justifiable. Pass requires no material defect. Overall verdict is fail if any dimension fails,
uncertain if any dimension is uncertain and none fails, otherwise pass. Give a concrete critique
for EVERY pair, citing the changed detail for defects. These are model judgments, not human labels.

Preserve scope and constraints. Do not invent context, requirements, or missing information. Do not perform the task.", "input": "could you turn this into a clear prompt for getting my geology field notebook entry tidied up, not write the entry itself? it's from the september 14 walk at alder creek, station 6 on the west bank, and i want the person using it to keep it as one dated field entry. my notes say the exposure is about 3.2 m high, dark fine-grained rock with two thin pale bands, and angular loose fragments below. i wrote that the contact might continue behind the brush, but i couldn't see it well, so keep that uncertain rather than making it definite. the bearing beside the sketch is marked \"roughly 040°\"; keep that exact wording, and note that no sample was collected. please ask for clear sentences and a sensible order, but don't have them add an interpretation, identify the rock, or fill gaps from general geology knowledge. i need a prompt that says the observations should stay intact, including the uncertainty and the no-sample detail, and that nothing should be presented as a measurement if the note only says about. make the recipient clear too: this should go to Ellis, not Leonie. don't turn the notebook material into a report or a new account of the walk.", "output": "Please tidy the geology field-notebook notes from the September 14 walk at Alder Creek, station 6 on the west bank, into one dated field entry for Ellis, not Leonie. Use clear sentences and a sensible order while keeping all observations intact: the exposure is about 3.2 m high, the rock is dark and fine-grained with two thin pale bands, and angular loose fragments lie below. Preserve the uncertainty that the contact might continue behind the brush, since it could not be seen well. Keep the bearing wording exactly as written: “roughly 040°.” Include that no sample was collected. Do not add an interpretation, identify the rock, fill gaps using general geology knowledge, or present an approximate value as an exact measurement. Do not turn the notes into a report or a new account of the walk."}]
